reply_text:
I've replied to Hollis in the DM to confirm that Gate 40 is their dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups from now on.

I first saved this to gbrain as a private fact, but gbrain stored it as visible to everyone (`visibility: world`) even though I asked for private. Because Hollis told me this in a DM, I withdrew it (fact #1) so other members can't pull it up. gbrain keeps an audit record of the withdrawal. The fact now lives only in that DM, which I can read back if Hollis asks later.

gbrain storing private saves as visible to everyone looks like a setup problem. Until the brain's owner fixes it, private saves there aren't safe. It also reported that this connection can't use some of its tools and suggested running `gbrain doctor --only grant_new_ops_available --json` on the brain's host.
